_comment: PRE-REGISTERED binding decision rule of the full 8-layer Qwen3.5-9B -> Gated DeltaNet conversion (Q9-AF, issue #87). Committed BEFORE any full-8 run, in its own commit. Applied by scripts/decide_full8.py only. Every constant comes from text that existed before job-5cmat ran (2026-10-06T21:33Z): the 511e8dd probe success_rule and gate (configs/probe9b_h100.json @ 511e8dd), and the full-8 gate row of HANDOFF.md / AGENT_HANDOFF.md @ caa8f55 ('per-layer gate dNLL <= 0.05, cumulative <= 0.15, hidden cos >= 0.95; on retrieval failure: no further spend, report the cost-of-attention-freedom curve, decision-needed on shipping a hybrid'). No constant was tuned on job-5cmat's numbers. Deltas are final converted model minus stock, same code path, same items.

gate._comment: The 511e8dd enforced gate, unchanged; n_windows 32 as shipped and run in job-5cmat (PR #73, a non-directional precision change disclosed there). Enforced in-run by convert.progressive (policy enforce: a failing layer is rolled back to attention and the loop continues with the next layer). decide_full8 re-computes every step's verdict from its recorded gate numbers and these constants; a mismatch is no-measurement.

quality._comment: 511e8dd success_rule bounds. Only the ppl bound is rescaled to 8 layers, because only for perplexity does pre-existing plan text give an 8-layer budget: the gate's cumulative dNLL budget 0.15 (vs teacher, wikitext-103 validation) bounds the same quantity that the held-out ppl ratio measures (wikitext-2 test), so ppl_ratio_max = exp(max_cum_delta_nll) = exp(0.15) = 1.16183, rounded DOWN to 1.1618. The 511e8dd one-layer bound 1.02 is the per-layer share of that budget (ln 1.02 = 0.0198 ~ 0.15 / 8 = 0.0188); keeping 1.02 for 8 layers would make the plan's own cumulative budget unreachable (any model the gate accepts with cumulative dNLL > 0.02 would fail). MMLU and Index have no 8-layer scaling in any plan text, so their 511e8dd bounds apply unchanged (stricter for 8 layers than for 1).

retrieval._comment: 511e8dd bounds, unchanged (no 8-layer scaling exists in the plan).

verdicts.q9af-backbone: all 8 attention layers accepted by the gate (the model is attention-free) AND every quality and retrieval bound passes -> Q9-AF becomes the m2 decision-cell backbone: pin gdn_converted.pt's sha256 in jobs/m2_pilot/m2_pilot_cell_q9af.json (q9af.converted_sha256) in its own reviewed PR, then the m2 parent arm and pilot cell run with PARENT=q9af
verdicts.retrieval-fail: all 8 accepted, quality passes, MQAR or S-NIAH past its bound -> PLAN pre-registered fallback: attention is NOT added back; the cost-of-attention-freedom curve (8..0 attention layers, from this job's per-layer probes) is reported; Q9-AF stays the pure-recurrent entrant (PLAN); which backbone m2 uses (Q9-AF anyway, RWKV7, or a hybrid) is decision-needed for the user; no further conversion spend
verdicts.quality-fail: all 8 accepted but ppl / MMLU / Index past its bound -> fold: the m2 backbone is RWKV7 (the DECISION_TREE quality-fail mapping); the Q9-AF weights are archived as measured, not pinned
verdicts.partial-conversion: the gate rejected 1-7 layers: the result is a hybrid with 8-N attention layers, NOT attention-free, so it can never be the Q9-AF backbone (heads.backbone.q9af_from_stock refuses it). It is reported as 'Q9-H<8-N>' with the same quality / retrieval / Index numbers (non-binding for Q9-AF) and the curve; the m2 backbone defaults to RWKV7 (attention-free); shipping the hybrid is decision-needed for the user; no re-conversion of rejected layers without a new spend issue and a new pre-registered rule
verdicts.no-conversion: the gate rejected all 8 layers -> fold: the m2 backbone is RWKV7; Index arms are skipped (nothing converted)

no_verdict: a pipeline stop (exit 3/4), fewer than 8 layers attempted (deadline / crash), an inconsistent gate record or a missing number is 'no-measurement' / 'stopped': exit 9, never a verdict, no spend authorised; the checkpoint keeps every finished layer
